mapper.insert: INSERT INTO picture_stats (pictureId, viewCount, likeCount, collectCount, downloadCount, shareCount, impressionCount, clickCount, ctr, createTime, updateTime) VALUES (#{stats.pictureId}, COALESCE(#{stats.viewCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.likeCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.collectCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.downloadCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.shareCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.impressionCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.clickCount}, 0), CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{stats.impressionCount}, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(#{stats.clickCount}, 0) / COALESCE(#{stats.impressionCount}, 0) ELSE 0.000000 END, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE viewCount = viewCount + COALESCE(#{stats.viewCount}, 0), likeCount = likeCount + COALESCE(#{stats.likeCount}, 0), collectCount = collectCount + COALESCE(#{stats.collectCount}, 0), downloadCount = downloadCount + COALESCE(#{stats.downloadCount}, 0), shareCount = shareCount + COALESCE(#{stats.shareCount}, 0), impressionCount = impressionCount + COALESCE(#{stats.impressionCount}, 0), clickCount = clickCount + COALESCE(#{stats.clickCount}, 0), ctr = CASE WHEN impressionCount > 0 THEN clickCount / impressionCount ELSE 0.000000 END, updateTime = NOW()
